title: Canonical CW Object Schema
negative_results: a CanonicalCoordinate with an empty frame_id is refused (invariant 9, ClaimError)
a CanonicalCoordinate with an empty epoch is refused (invariant 9, ClaimError)
an out-of-range shell_state (not in 0..8) is refused
a CanonicalCWAddress with no raw vector is refused (invariant 1)
a corrupted raw vector makes verify_checksum() return False
an OK_POINT CodecResult with no candidate is refused

claims.statement: CanonicalCWAddress carries all architecture fields (version, namespace, body_id, frame_id, epoch, horizontal_coordinate, radial_coordinate, shell_state, local_residual, codec_id, checksum, uncertainty, provenance) and projects to cw_vector.schema.json; CodecResult projects to codec_result.schema.json.
A canonical address requires a declared CRS (frame) and epoch; a raw vector string is immutable and bound by a checksum.
A typed canonical object says nothing about whether any operator-reported source vector identifies a real location.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
